findings.problemShort: delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used
findings.solutionShort: ensure <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh
findings.solutionLong:
Fix any of the following:
  <meta> tag forces timed refresh of page (less than 20 hours)
